description: Serving craft mocktails and small bites. 100% you, 0% alcohol.
name: Urban Glow Mocktails

description: Afro Bean Pops are handcrafted fritters made from finely ground black-eyed peas, blended with fresh onions, spices, and a touch of heat. Each bite bursts with savory flavor and a satisfying crunch. These classic black-eyed pea fritters are crunchy on the outside, fluffy inside, and infused with just the right balance of spices. Enjoy them solo or with a spicy chili red sauce
name: Afro Bean Pops

description:
Homemade Whipped Feta topped with schug — a bold, Mediterranean spicy relish made from jalapeños, garlic, cilantro, and warm spices. It’s finished with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkle of toasted wild rice for added texture.

Served with crispy deep-fried flatbread dusted in our signature Dino’s Greek seasoning.
name: Athena's Whipped Feta

description: It’s officially time for the Sprinkle Party! Made from scratch cake batter cookie dough covered in a crunchy cake confetti she’ll. Topped with rainbow sprinkles and served on a stick! It’s sweet, crunchy and rainbow sprinkly Doughlicious! It’s perfect for the whole family!
name: Birthday Cake Cookie Dough On-A-Stick

description: Bison and bacon meatballs, from Minnesota-based Eichten's Bison and Hidden Stream Farm, topped with bison gravy, quick-pickled cucumbers, crispy fried onions and sour cream. Served on a toasted wild rice hoagie bun.
name: Bison Meatball Sub

description: Cannoli chips topped with a scoop of cannoli-flavored gelato. Finished with chocolate sauce, rainbow sprinkles and a cherry!
name: Cannoli Gelato Nachos

description: Mozzarella cheese curds breaded with Italian seasoning and deep fried. Served over a bruschetta-flavored blend of tomatoes and basil, and drizzled with balsamic glaze. Served with a side of crostini for scooping.
name: Caprese Curds

description: Limeade juice topped with cherry Dole Soft Serve, garnished with a lime slice and a cherry.
name: Cherry Bigfoot Limeade Float

description: Freshly baked flaky pie crust strips covered in cinnamon and sugar. Served with a side of whiskey-flavored caramel dipping sauce.
name: Cinna-sugar Crust Tidbits

description: Croissant pressed in a waffle iron and topped with fresh whipped sweet cream, a drizzle of fruit puree and a cloud of cotton candy. Choice of three flavors: Banana Caramel – caramel drizzle with banana taffy cotton candy; Yuzu Meringue – yuzu puree with lemon meringue cotton candy; or Coconut Cream – coconut drizzle with coconut cotton candy.
name: Croffle Cloud

description: Bites of breaded tofu, deep fried and tossed in a tangy, spicy sauce. Served on a bed of pineapple and napa cabbage slaw. Topped with sesame seeds and scallions.
name: Deep-Fried Tofuego Bites

description: Brewed black tea infused with dill pickle flavor and served with a dill pickle spear. Garnished with a rim of chamoy, Tajin, salt and dill. (Vegan, Gluten Free)
name: Dill Pickle Iced Tea

description: Falafel waffle, tahini butter, cherry tomatoes, traditional hummus, green shatta, mint, toasted sesame seeds
name: Fawaffle

description: Fried chicken filled rolled tacos, served in a cup with warm salsa verde, crema & crumbly queso
name: Flauta Dippers

description: Freaky Fryday features three pieces of Bacon fried chicken and three strips of chicken fried bacon! All vegan. Guests can choose from four topping options: dill pickle seasoning with ranch dressing, cinnamon sugar with maple syrup, spicy Dragon Dust with buffalo sauce, or a combination of all three.
name: Freaky Fryday

description: Oasis Mediterranean Grill will be serving up refreshing watermelon and Vimto slushies alongside their flavorful Somali Street Fries. Hoyo Sambusa offers handmade sambusas filled with savory meats or lentils, celebrating Somali tradition in every bite.
name: Midtown Global Market's Indigenous Food Lab

description: Vanilla ice cream, created by Minnesota Dairy Lab, sandwiched between two pieces of Grandma Doreen’s Coffee Cake – a family recipe from Elgin, Minn. – made by Wrecktangle Pizza. Skewered on-a-stick and drizzled with house-made strawberry rhubarb jam. Garnished with cinnamon toast-flavored crispy treats, whipped cream and sprinkles. (Vegetarian)
name: Grandma Doreen's Dessert Dog

description: Tart green apple ice cream with swirls of sweet caramel – flavored like a caramel apple lollipop – served in a cup. Created by A to Z Creamery.
name: Green Apple Sucker Ice Cream

description: Donut topped with jalapeno cream cheese, bacon, pickled jalopenos, and hot honey
name: Hot Honey Jalapeno Popper Donut

description: Sweet, spicy, cheesy perfection in every bite: Cheese curds, pepperoni, and our secret herb-parmesan blend stuffed into a golden pizza ball, topped with diced pepperoni and a hot honey drizzle!
name: Hot Honey Pizza Ballzz

description: Slow-smoked pork collar caramelized with Hawaiian barbecue sauce, inspired by the flavors of traditional Hawaiian Kalua pork. Served atop a charred banana leaf with banana chips and Japanese quick-pickled cucumbers on the side. Finished with a sprinkle of coarse red sea salt.
name: Hula Kalua Pork

description: The 'Land of 10,000 Cakes' is a triple layer Marble sundae made with Bridgeman's premium Butter Brittle Ice Cream and layered with a trio of mini Nadia Cupcakes - Creme Brulee, Loaded Pistachio and Chocolate Bliss topped with whipped cream and a cherry.
name: Land of 10,000 Cakes

description: Pull-apart donut dough baked with Minnesota-grown Honeycrisp apples. Topped with brown sugar pecan streusel and orange blossom maple glaze. (Vegetarian)
name: Apple Glaze Patisserie Sweets

description: These are a blend of cheddar cheese, pimento peppers and mayo, wrapped in a crispy and deep fried shell. Served with a side of pepper jelly.
name: Pimento Cheese Puffs

description: Cheese curds with pepperoni and sausage flavor in a crispy shell and topped with pizza sauce and cheese
name: Pizza Cheese Curd Tacos

description: A mixture of ground pork and shrimp combined with Hmong aromatics – lemongrass, ginger, garlic, shallots and Thai chilis – seasoned with fish sauce, spread on Texas toast and deep fried. Served on-a-stick with a side of apricot jelly hot sauce.
name: Shrimp & Pork Toast On-A-Stick

description: Smashed seasoned ground beef and Gouda cheese grilled on a flour tortilla. Served folded and dressed with caramelized onions, lettuce, pickles and Gass Station Grill's homemade burger sauce.
name: Smashadilla

description: A blend of Somali Beef Suqaar – spiced beef, vegetables, cheese and herbs – piled  on a bed of french fries. Topped with white garlic sauce and green jalapeño hot sauce.
name: Somali Street Fries

description: White cheddar cheese curds coated in a funnel cake batter, deep fried, and topped with a scoop of fresh lemon whipped cream. Finished with a drizzle of berry sauce.
name: Sweet Squeakers

description: This creation combines savory Italian sausage, creamy mozzarella, and rich cream cheese, all seasoned to perfection with a hint of barbecue rub. The mixture is expertly piped into tender manicotti shells, wrapped in crispy bacon, and infused with smoky flavors from our wood-fired smoker. Served with a side of Giggles’ signature dipping sauce.
name: Timber Twists

description: A 4 oz. hamburger patty with cheese, pickles and special sauce, sandwiched between two deep-fried peanut butter & grape jelly Uncrustables®.
name: Uncrustaburger

description: Beans & Beignets serves freshly made beignets (deep-fried pastry dough topped with powdered sugar), plus a variety of iced and hot beverages, including tea, coffee, chai lattes and espresso drinks.
name: Beans & Beignets

description: Pot of Gold Potato Dumplings made by Saturdaydumplingco - Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, served with the one and only Top The Tater. Find them at O’Gara’s — where comfort food meets fair season.
name: Pot of Gold Dumplings

description: Our Triple Chocolate Mini Donuts are dusted with powdered sugar, drizzled with chocolate icing, and topped with chocolate sprinkles and mini milk chocolate chips. Served in a bucket rimmed with more chocolate icing and sprinkles and they're vegetarian! It’s a flavor explosion you won’t want to miss!
name: Triple Chocolate Mini Donuts

description: Chocolate Strawberry Cup serves fresh strawberries in a cup with toppings in four flavors: Dubai Chocolate Strawberry Cup (layered with Belgian-style chocolate, pistachio butter, kataifi and pistachios); Matcha White Chocolate Strawberry Cup (layered with matcha white chocolate and melted chocolate topped with marshmallow sauce); Chocolate Strawberry Cup (covered with melted Belgian-style chocolate); and Chocolate Strawberries & Cream (covered in melted chocolate and topped with a tower of whipped cream and chocolate drizzle). All strawberry cups are gluten free, except the Dubai chocolate cup.
name: Chocolate Strawberry Cup

description: Greater Tater serves Tater Kegs – jumbo deep-fried tots stuffed with savory fillings – in five flavors: Bacon Jalapeño; Bacon Cheddar; Breakfast Skillet; Cheese Bomb; and Reuben. Served with choice of sauces: thousand island, blue cheese, Top the Tater®, maple syrup and ketchup. All Tater Kegs are gluten free.
name: Greater Tater

description: Lumpia City serves lumpia – traditional Filipino fried spring rolls – in two fusion flavors: Pizza Lumpia (mozzarella, pepperoni, Italian sausage, pizza sauce and Italian herbs); and turon-inspired Ube Butter Banana French Toast Lumpia (French toast strips soaked in ube butter syrup with caramelized bananas, dusted with powdered sugar).
name: Lumpia City

description: Magdalen's Chimney Cakes sells a rotisserie baked pastry shaped like a cone, filled with sweets like Nutella or caramel, stuffed with ice cream and topped like a sundae
name: Magdalena's Chimney Cakes

description: Irie Jamaican Express is bringing bold island flavor to the fair with their new BBQ and jerk oxtail served on fry bread, plus other authentic Jamaican dishes.
name: Midtown Global Market's MomoDosa

description:
100% beef bacon cut like fries double battered in tempura flour fried to golden perfection. Served with TWO signature sauces:

Cashville Hot – a spicy-sweet brown sugar Nashville hot blend 24K Gold BBQ – a passion fruit Charleston gold BBQ sauce that’s tangy, smoky, and pure gold in flavor
name: Chicken-Fried Bacon Fries

description:
Tandoori chicken + cheese + peppers folded into flaky paratha.
Griddled to perfection + served with our Avocado Cilantro Lime Sauce.
It’s next level!
name: Tandoori Chicken Quesaratha
